findings.powermetrics_error: powermetrics must be invoked as the superuser
findings.reason: The supported command-line template provides sampled bottleneck categories, not a documented retired-instruction count per operation. Private kperf or privileged system-wide sampling would make the benchmark nonportable and still require explicit phase markers. Retain xctrace as an auxiliary profiler and use alternating long-window wall-time samples for matrix acceptance.
